description: Lesson a6: KY-040 rotary encoder on TIM4 encoder mode 3 (PB6 CLK / PB7 DT, input filter 15), 4 counts per detent, 'pos=<n>' at every new detent, debounced push switch on PB12; PB13 low at reset also prints every raw count
expect:
72 MHz. TIM4 encoder mode 3 (TI12: every edge of CLK and DT counts, up while CLK leads DT), IC1F = IC2F = 15 (an edge must hold 256 timer clocks = 3.6 us; shorter glitches are ignored), ARR 65535. PB6 / PB7 floating inputs (the KY-040 has 10 kOhm pull-ups), PB12 input with pull-up (SW, the module has no pull-up), PB13 input with pull-up read once at reset (experiment jumper). USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'KY-040 lesson a6: TIM4 encoder CLK PB6 / DT PB7, filter 15, SW PB12
' ('PB13 low: raw TIM4 count on every edge (4 per detent)
' with the jumper) then 'pos=0
'. The main loop wakes every SysTick (WFI) and prints 'pos=<CNT/4>
' whenever the signed 16-bit count is a multiple of 4 and differs from the last report (one detent clockwise: CLK falls, DT falls, CLK rises, DT rises -> 'pos=1'; counter-clockwise -> 'pos=-1'; half a detent and back counts +2 -2 and prints nothing); with the PB13 jumper also 'cnt=<count>
' for every change of the count. PB12 low for 20 ms prints 'SW pressed
', back high for 20 ms 'SW released
' (contact bounce restarts the 20 ms).

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
PB13: open (the raw-count experiment jumper to GND is not placed)

boot.USART1:
KY-040 lesson a6: TIM4 encoder CLK PB6 / DT PB7, filter 15, SW PB12
pos=0

scenarios.name: one detent clockwise (CLK leads DT) reports pos=1
one detent counter-clockwise (DT leads CLK) reports pos=-1
half a detent and back counts +2 -2: no report
a 2 us glitch on CLK is shorter than the input filter: no count
a bouncing press counts once, 19-20 ms after the last edge (1 ms tick); the release too
